reply.text: Straps are a fine tool when the goal is working your back and legs past what your grip can hold — pulling heavy, doing high-rep work, or just not wanting grip to be the thing that ends a top set. But if you never train grip, grip never catches up. Good middle ground: pull your working sets without straps, and strap up only for the heaviest ones or any back-off volume where grip failure is cutting the set short. Mixed grip or just hook grip work on the side helps too. Keep deadlifting.
